title: How US Inflation and GDP Data Move Sensex and Nifty: What November 2026 Means for Indian Investors
description: US inflation and GDP data point to a December Fed rate hike, yet Sensex and Nifty rallied on record FII inflows. We explain how US data reaches Indian stocks through FII flows, the rupee and sectors like IT, banks and metals.
labels: US inflation impact on Indian stock market
author: AadhiMahi
